sections.title: Basic Facts
sections.content: Location São Tomé and Príncipe is located in West Africa, in the Gulf of Guinea. It consists of the islands of São Tomé, Príncipe, Pedras Tinhosas, Caroço, and Rôlas. Area The country has a total area of 1,001 sq km (386 sq. mi.), making it the smallest country in Africa. Population The estimated population is approximately 235,536 people. Main Cities The capital city is São Tomé. Other important cities include Trinidade, Santana, Angolares, Neves, and Santo Antonio. https://www.saotomeexpert.pt/en/sao -tome -and-principe -factsheet -geography - climate/

sections.title: Geography & Climate
sections.content: The country is characterized by two main mountainous islands that are part of a chain of extinct volcanoes. The terrain is largely volcanic and tropical. São Tomé and Príncipe has a tropical climate with wet and dry seasons. Weather conditions are strongly influenced by the mountainous landscape. The country also faces environmental challenges such as rising sea levels and floods due to climate change. Sao Tome and Principe (07/03)

subsections.title: Customs & Traditions
subsections.content: One of the country’s most important cultural traditions is “ Tchiloli ,” a traditional theatrical performance that represents themes of justice and social values. It is recognized by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage.

subsections.title: Social Habits
subsections.content: Religion plays an important role in society, with Roman Catholicism and Evangelical Protestantism being the dominant religions. subsections.title: General Wealth
subsections.content: São Tomé and Príncipe is considered a developing economy. In December 2024, the country graduated from the “Least Developed Countries” (LDC) category. Its Gross National Income (GNI) per capita reached approximately $2,271 during 2020 –2022. The economy remains highly dependent on commodity exports, especially cocoa beans, which accounted for about 69% of merchandise exports between 2021 and 2023. The country also faces economic challenges including debt distress, geographic isolation, and slo w economic growth.

subsections.title: Education & Literacy Rates
subsections.content: The literacy rate is approximately 84.9%. The country has implemented educational reforms through the Lei de Bases do Sistema Educativo (LBSE). In addition, the Human Assets Index increased significantly from 59.3 in 2002 to 91.4 in 2024, reflecting improve ments in education and human development. n.° 2 / 2003.
